Command Center

Multi-race operational overview for ROC supervisors — one interface covering all ongoing events, live incident feeds, athlete counts, and a global race map.

  • Single view of all active races — no more switching between systems during race day
  • Live incident feed with dispatch shortcuts, race clock, and weather per event
  • Global race map and directory covering all upcoming and finished events
ⓘ  Live and integrated — the Command Center is now receiving real incident data from the field, end-to-end.

Incident View

Screens for the end-to-end incident lifecycle — from a field report to command-center resolution — with a live course map and full athlete medical context.

  • Field-to-command in one flow: staff report incidents on mobile; coordinators manage them from the web command center on a live course map
  • Full medical context at every step, from first report through to resolution
  • Real-time resource tracking — medics, ambulances, helicopters, and vehicles, per race
  • V1 incident types: Medical, Weather, Transportation, and Others
ⓘ  Live and integrated — incident creation and viewing are now wired to real data on both the app and the web command center.

Open Floor

Testing & Adoption Planning

01
Testing Approach — 4 Phases

Plan validated yesterday with John Bertsch and James Hines: adoption rolls out in 4 phases, each gated by a feedback and go/no-go checkpoint before moving on.

Phase 1
Hybrid tabletop + guided user tasks — no real race scenarios yet
Phase 2
Same session format, extended to a broader team beyond the core project group
Phase 3
Field test in shadow / parallel mode alongside a live race operation
Phase 4
Pilot at a chosen event with the app running live

› Between each phase: feedback round → mandatory improvement triage → go/no-go decision to advance or rerun.

02
Phase 1 — Scope & Session Design
Session Timebox — 1 Hour, Remote
0–10 min Access & Setup
10–45 min Guided Tasks
45–60 min Live Feedback
Tools
  • Teams for facilitation
  • FigJam board for live feedback
  • LogRocket to record & analyze sessions afterward
Web + App In Parallel
  • Command center / leadership primarily on web; field staff on the app
  • Suggested: main tasks on web, app for notifications & chat
Features In Scope
  • Login, profile, home dashboard, race page, chat, and live communications
Reserved For Later Phases
  • With the responsible ops teams: incident management, PCR, kiosk
Advance Criteria — Phase 1 → Phase 2
  • No critical bugs blocking features
  • Sufficient operational confidence score from participants
  • All improvement needs mapped and confirmed non-blocking

FigJam feedback board — one lane per participant, live checklist and colour-coded stickies during the session.

03
